acceptance_criteria: A synchronously rejected invocation cannot suppress a later crash or produce a completion acknowledgement.
A timeout or lost invocation response remains outcome-unknown until correlated generation evidence resolves it.
A successful restart correlates a replacement process generation and health or capability proof to the opaque request before publishing completion.
Crash suppression, completion-alert handoff, and originating-chat acknowledgement use independent durable acknowledgement fields, so either consumer order converges without starvation.
Crash before, during, and after replacement startup preserves a truthful failed, ambiguous, or completed transaction and the correct notification obligations.
Completion-alert rejection and delayed-chat-journal failure retain bounded retry ownership across another restart.
Repeated request, startup, OnFailure, and retry consumers are idempotent for one opaque transaction identity.
Stale transactions expire through an explicit bounded disposition and cannot suppress a future unrelated failure.

Focused tests cover rejected invocation, timeout, response loss, accepted restart, absent or wrong generation, early replacement crash, both consumer orderings, alert rejection, chat-journal rejection, restart, and expiry.
Receipts and diagnostics contain only bounded phase and reason codes, timestamps, and opaque hashes.
blast_radius: Agent-triggered self-restart, service-manager invocation outcomes, startup continuity, OnFailure crash classification, BOT ERRORS request and completion alerts, originating-chat acknowledgement, retry behavior, stale-receipt expiry, and operator recovery evidence.
evidence_summary: Exact pinned blobs show the request writes one marker before the checked request alert and service-manager invocation, deliberately retains it after a fast invocation rejection, and never records the alert result. Startup independently consumes and deletes that marker before an unchecked completion alert and before a process-local three-second delayed chat handoff. The OnFailure script independently deletes the same fresh marker and exits before gathering crash evidence. Twelve write-free exact-source assertions passed, and a content-free in-memory transition canary reproduced rejected-request crash suppression, rejected-request false completion, early replacement crash after destructive consumption, and either consumer starving the other. Current tests explicitly codify rejected-invocation retention, consume-and-delete, warning-only completion-ping rejection, and crash-alert suppression. Full pagination of 38 open pull requests, 42 changed-file pages, and 1,327 changed files found no implementation owner; four open pull requests collide with decisive paths without changing this transaction. A final path-level audit found every recorded decisive, test, and affected path disjoint from the exact 6e1672766027c16ecb06f5e122b491c0e5a0a83f to 45f4889ab5f971d920ca6a05bf857d326c42b81d delta; API and SSH main matched the latter revision, so this record is safely repinned. falsifier_or_remaining_gap: A versioned transaction would falsify the surviving defect if failure-injection tests prove rejected and outcome-unknown invocations cannot authorize crash suppression or completion, replacement-generation proof is correlated to the request, crash classification and both notification obligations have independent durable acknowledgement fields, both consumer orderings converge idempotently, and stale state expires explicitly. The 75-test registry model suite passed, but no issue-specific behavior suite or live restart was run because the bounded audit prohibited temporary artifacts and service or process mutation; behavior beyond exact source contracts and the in-memory transition canary remains unobserved.
impact: A rejected restart request can suppress a later unrelated crash or be reported as completed by an unrelated startup. A genuine restart can lose crash classification or completion continuity depending on consumer order, and an early replacement-process crash can erase the only transaction evidence before either completion notification has durable ownership.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2511 identity, labels, body hash, and pinned remote main immediately before registry integration or metadata mutation.
Re-enumerate every open pull request changed-file list immediately before assigning an implementation owner, with explicit attention to preservation PRs #2078, #2500, and #2501.
Land or explicitly reuse issue #2476 replacement-generation and health-proof receipt semantics before claiming restart completion.

Reconcile alert-source policy with issue #2147, cross-contract taxonomy with issue #2447, restart recovery-clear authority with issue #2394, and notification outcome truth with issues #2424, #2434, and #2510 without merging their owner boundaries.

Require RED and GREEN failure-injection tests for invocation rejection, outcome unknown, both consumer orderings, early replacement crash, alert rejection, chat-journal rejection, restart, and expiry on the exact implementation head.
Keep live service restarts, deployment, queue mutation, and message delivery outside the draft implementation pull request.
Preserve bounded privacy-safe receipts without host, user, unit, process, destination, message, path, credential, account, or private topology values.
